title: Elytra MITE
description: Brought the Elytra from vanilla Minecraft 1.9+ into 1.6.4-MITE, along with a reworked way to obtain it.
body:
## How to obtain
Defeat the EnderDragon to obtain an Elytra Template, then craft the Elytra using the Template, leather, string, and feather
![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8a236a4edab9da0900afcd6418059d65572b9206.png)

You can duplicate the Elytra Template by combining it with a Book and Quill.
![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d33c1c736655b8bf449d44ff0a72f63a9b1624c.png)

## Enchanting and Repairing
The Elytra can be repaired using leather, and it can be enchanted with Protection and Fire Protection.
![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb46386cc341f2ae8fe55a71ddc29a2a215661d4.png)
![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34ba2d078afe469cb92093efe247d43d718e7832.png)
![screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ce1274141b3b13c49455587241081b5c0d2a35d7.png)

## Additional Changes
This mod changes the flight duration of all tiers of Firework Rockets to 3. So feel free to craft the most cost-effective Firework Rocket (using paper and 1 gunpowder).
